title: 前《铁拳》总监原田胜弘谈VS Studio下一款游戏
text:
相关文章: 《铁拳7》《铁拳8》总监离职万代南梦宫
《铁拳》系列前负责人原田胜弘终于透露了自己下一款游戏的一些细节，该项目目前正在他的独立开发工作室VS Studio制作中。
原田胜弘今年早些时候正式离开万代南梦宫，结束了自己在公司数十年的任职生涯，也卸下了长期以来作为《铁拳》系列核心掌舵人的身份，转而成立自己的工作室。VS Studio是SNK旗下子公司，过去几个月一直在逐步扩充团队，并吸纳了多位曾参与《铁拳》核心开发工作的成员。
虽然原田此前对于VS Studio究竟正在制作什么一直相当低调，但在2026年9月接受VideoGamesChronicle采访时，他透露了一些当前项目的信息，而至少从目前来看，这对于喜欢他过去作品的粉丝来说似乎是个好消息。
当被问到VS Studio的下一款游戏是否会是一款格斗游戏，或者这家工作室是否打算成为一家「不局限于特定类型」的公司时，原田表示：「我能说的是，确实有一些过去和我共事过的成员加入了公司，不过这完全是他们自愿的选择。……我们正在制作的作品目前还没有公开，不过正如我刚才所说，我不想辜负粉丝对我们的期待。我们正在开发的游戏会带来某种惊喜，但大家可以放心，它不会是完全超出预期的东西。」
虽然这番话并没有明确确认什么，但至少说明原田正在制作的项目，多少还是处于粉丝预期的范围之内——而在我们看来，这听起来很像是一款格斗游戏。（另外值得一提的是，在VS Studio消息最初公布之后，原田本人也曾在接受Den-fami Nico Gamer采访时表示，他希望开发一款新的格斗游戏。） 还有更多相关内容 《铁拳8》「范马勇次郎」预告
至于这会是一款完全原创的新IP，还是现有系列的新作，目前仍有待观察。不过SNK首席发行官Ozan Kocoglu表示，VS Studio并不排斥同时制作原创作品，以及进一步拓展他们过去参与过的项目。他说：「我认为两种可能都有。我们不应该被限制在其中一条道路上。我认为原田先生能够凭借自己丰富的经验，帮助我们现有IP以不同方式成长，或者和小田先生这样的人一起推动这些IP进入下一个阶段。但与此同时，随着SNK正在成长为一家规模更大、面貌更新的公司，我们同样需要新鲜的想法。我们也需要建立新的IP支柱，而他完全可能参与其中，让这些新IP真正丰富SNK现有的作品阵容。我当然认为原田先生两边都可以做，最终还是要看他想做什么、想以怎样的方式去做，以及未来他可能会和我们的哪些开发负责人合作、参与哪些IP。」
Kocoglu还透露，SNK目前正处于「积极扩张」阶段，并表示公司需要一种「全新的视角」才能继续向前发展。他也认为，VS Studio没有理由成为SNK一次性的尝试，并称原田是「对我们目前正在打造的公司DNA来说非常出色的补充」。他补充道：「但我们会只停在VS Studio这里吗？我觉得这并不是我们的想法。接下来我们会继续思考：市场上还有哪些新的机会？我们希望公司怎样成长？就我个人而言，我认为SNK在动作类游戏方面拥有非常鲜明的DNA。所以未来，任何正在制作动作类项目的人，都有可能加入我们。」
原田随后表示，VS Studio拥有「非常高的自由度」，虽然团队「想做什么都可以」，但他们依然必须考虑粉丝和玩家对自己的期待。他说：「我想守住的，一方面是自己擅长的东西，另一方面也是满足粉丝对我的期待。在此基础上，我也希望与SNK展开合作。我们可以分享各自拥有的电子游戏开发经验，并在游戏制作方式上互相强化彼此的优势。所以，我会专注于自己擅长的领域，同时把玩家的期待放在心上，并与SNK保持紧密合作。」
原田还谈到了自己离开万代南梦宫后，对于《铁拳》系列未来的看法。他透露，在发展VS Studio的同时，自己也一直在指导《铁拳》现有开发团队的成员。他说：「我并不了解自己离开之后《铁拳》接下来会有什么安排，所以我觉得大家最好直接去问万代南梦宫。现在的我也只能和粉丝一样进行猜测。不过有一点我可以说，我一直都在努力指导《铁拳》团队的成员，而且我可以保证，那些现在还在参与这个项目的人，已经取得了进步和成长。所以如今我会以一个粉丝的身份，期待《铁拳》的未来。」
相关文章: 《铁拳8》第三赛季宣传视频

title: 《卧龙2：凤火连天》发售日预告
text:
将于2027年3月4日发售
战火蔽日，凤舞长空。时值东汉末年，天下三分，英雄逐鹿。 兵连祸结，诸般信念激荡交锋；沙场喋血，异形妖魔横行肆虐——无止境的混沌之下，一位侠士横空出世。《卧龙2：凤火连天（Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember）》将于2027年3月4日登陆PS5、XBOX Series、Switch 2及PC平台，同步加入Game Pass游戏库。

title: PS5版《控制：共振》游戏特性宣传视频
text:
探索广阔的腐化都市
迪伦·法登在联邦控制局被监禁多年。在超自然危机愈演愈烈之时，曾使他身陷囹圄的人又把他推到了战斗一线。一个神秘的宇宙实体正在篡改现实世界的法则，迪伦肩负起了对抗它的重任，如今他必须驾驭新获得的力量，主动迎击肆虐曼哈顿的无数威胁。作为《控制》的续作，本作将带你与迪伦一同探索广阔的腐化都市，直面混沌希斯、侵入性微生物「霉菌」以及其他扭曲的超自然威胁。在全面激发超自然潜能的过程中，迪伦还要寻找身为控制局局长的姐姐杰西·法登，同时努力了解并遏制从太古屋散逸的危险力量，而这股力量企图撕裂我们所处的世界。《控制：共振》将于9月24日登陆PS5、XBOX Series及PC平台。

title: 《KEMURI》宣传视频 | TGS 2026

text:
揭开一段跨越数百年的复仇与牵绊的故事
曾经爆发的惨烈战争、能够操控拥有强大力量的神秘存在「幻兽」的谜之少女、以及破坏各地「水晶」的铠甲男。一切错综交织，揭开一段跨越数百年的复仇与牵绊的故事。以回合制指令战斗为基础，融入持续攻击敌人即可使其无法行动的「破防」系统，以及强力必杀技「共鸣」，体验更具战略性的战斗。《最终幻想 RESONANCE》将于10月22日登陆PS5、XBOX Series、Switch及Switch 2平台，Steam版将于10月23日发售。

title: 《双点博物馆》「失落游乐园」DLC发售日预告
text:
心动不如行动

title: 《收获日2》「即刻落锤」宣传视频
text:
贝恩正紧追一场寻宝之旅的线索

title: 《植物大战僵尸》桌游10月开启众筹
text:
相关文章: 《植物大战僵尸 重植版》媒体赞誉宣传视频
PopCap旗下广受欢迎、运营多年的PvE游戏系列《植物大战僵尸》将被改编成桌面游戏，由Mantic Games负责制作。该项目计划于10月14日在Kickstarter开启众筹。
Mantic此前已经将《百战天虫》《光环》《地狱男爵》《行尸走肉》和《无敌少侠》等多个IP改编为桌面游戏。官方将这款《植物大战僵尸》桌游描述为「一款节奏明快的合作桌游，捕捉到了系列中的喜剧感与混乱感」。 还有更多相关内容 《植物大战僵尸 重植版》评测
游戏支持1至4名玩家游玩，「玩家需要共同合作，挑战一系列难度逐渐提升的关卡。每个关卡都会拥有独特的布局、目标，以及需要击败的僵尸群。」
这会是一款以卡牌为核心的游戏，不同卡牌打出后会产生各自独特的效果。其中包括植物卡，比如可以发动豌豆射手攻击，或者引爆樱桃炸弹。除此之外，还有工具卡，比如铲子可以重新调整花园中的防御布局，割草机则可以直接清除一整条路线上的僵尸。
与此同时，打出僵尸卡会让它们进一步接近你的房屋，同时也会向玩家显示这些僵尸接下来将沿着哪些路线移动，理论上可以让玩家更好地提前布置防御。你必须同时打出手中的所有僵尸卡，这应该会进一步增加每局游戏的紧张感和混乱程度。随着游戏推进，玩家还可以解锁新的植物、僵尸以及挑战，而每一个新关卡都会让玩家面对全新的僵尸群。如果有任何僵尸成功抵达房屋，玩家就会输掉游戏。
Mantic还在准备一个豪华版，其中会附带预先组装完成的「粉丝喜爱植物与僵尸」模型。另外还会推出一个可以独立游玩的「夜间版」扩展，其中会加入更多植物、僵尸以及其他内容。
上一款《植物大战僵尸》游戏是去年推出的《植物大战僵尸 重植版》，这是初代作品的重制版，我们认为它表现不错。系列上一款真正意义上的新作则是2024年的《植物大战僵尸3》，这是一款免费游玩的手机游戏，并且已经经历过多次重新上线。

title: 樱井政博因无人接班停办游戏设计师奖
text:
相关文章: 爆料称任天堂正开发《大乱斗》新作
樱井政博透露，「游戏设计师奖」将不会继续出现在日本游戏大奖中，因为他没能找到合适的人来接替自己。
日本游戏大奖的年度游戏部门颁奖于9月14日举行，表彰日本游戏开发领域最出色的作品与创作者。虽然现场有大量游戏和创意人才获奖，但其中一个奖项格外引人关注——因为它未来不会再出现在日本游戏大奖的舞台上。
《星之卡比》和《任天堂明星大乱斗》的创作者樱井政博于2010年创立了「游戏设计师奖」。根据CESA官网介绍，这一奖项主要根据游戏的创意和原创性进行评选。入围作品必须融入「明显区别于既有作品的新想法」，并且「通过为用户提供全新的享受和游玩方式，拓展游戏软件的表现形式」。
「游戏设计师奖」最终会授予「能够触及包括平时并不积极玩游戏的人在内的广泛人群，并在当年留下令人难忘成绩的作品」。
今年获得这一奖项的是独立工作室Team9开发的《文字游戏》。这是一款以文字为核心的解谜游戏，最初使用繁体中文制作，后来又为日本玩家进行了本地化——这一点给评审委员会留下了非常深刻的印象。评审团共有11名成员，包括神谷英树、横尾太郎、Toby Fox等业内资深人士，而《文字游戏》最终获得了「游戏设计师奖」。
CESA官网写道：「即便是在第二轮评审、候选作品已经缩小到具体名单之后，本作依然以压倒性的票数获胜。更令人惊讶的是，虽然这款游戏看起来像是只有使用日语才能成立，但它实际上是由一款繁体中文作品本地化而来的。我相信，要完成这样的转换，一定需要非常高超的技术以及巧妙的解决方案。我认为，这款独特且不可复制的游戏，非常适合作为最后一届『游戏设计师奖』的获奖作品。」 还有更多相关内容 前概念艺术家证实迪士尼曾开发大乱斗游戏
遗憾的是，《文字游戏》将成为日本游戏大奖最后一款获得这一荣誉的作品，因为樱井政博至今仍没能找到合适的继任者，来帮他继续筛选未来的候选游戏。他在今年颁奖典礼的一段发言中解释了这一情况，同时也分享了自己对于整个行业的一些看法。樱井表示：「从我们开始设立这个奖项算起，已经过去16年了。今年是最后一年，而原因就是没有人来接替我。仅此而已。为了让这个奖项继续保持说服力，并真正发挥它应有的作用，负责评选的人必须是一名总监，而且他自己也应该做过那些富有创新性、显著改变游戏玩法的作品。我曾主动去寻找可以接替我的人。我也做过一些介绍和说明，希望找到合适的人选。我找了好几年，但没有人愿意站出来接替我。还有很多其他评委，但他们当中没有人能够接过这个责任。」
「游戏开发本身一直都是一种实验，但你还是得不断做下去。这始终是一个非常困难的过程。……虽然最高奖一直都很受关注，但我认为这个奖项展现的是游戏的另一个侧面。遗憾的是，创新并不总是和商业收益挂钩。并没有很多人会每次都去喝某种有趣饮料的最新口味。大多数时候，人们还是会选择自己已经习惯的东西。这种创新和创意总是很难得到认可，但如果这个行业失去了创意和创新，我认为整个行业都会慢慢死去。我们始终需要新的发现和新的创新，才能让这个行业保持新鲜、保持活力。」
樱井表示，他希望即便这个奖项消失之后，玩家也能「继续对富有创意的游戏保持兴趣」。过去三年获得「游戏设计师奖」的作品分别是Sad Owl Studios的《Viewfinder》、Odd Meter的《印蒂卡》，以及《RPG时间！光之传说》。
对于这一变化，不少粉丝都感到遗憾，不过他们也希望这意味着樱井能够腾出更多时间专注于新的项目——尤其是最近关于新一代《任天堂明星大乱斗》的传闻一直不断。
相关文章: 根据樱井政博游戏开发生涯改编的漫画将在日本推出

title: 据称华纳兄弟后悔毁掉施奈德版本的DC宇宙
text:
相关文章: 扎克·施奈德时隔多年重返华纳片场
据导演扎克·施奈德透露，一名前华纳兄弟高管曾对当年与他在DC宇宙创作方向上发生冲突一事表达后悔。
在接受Variety的新采访时，扎克·施奈德谈到了自己DC宇宙最终崩塌的经历，并称那是一个「低谷」。他透露，一名前华纳兄弟高管曾告诉他，他「所有事情都是对的」，并对当年在DC宇宙创作愿景上与他对抗表示懊悔。
施奈德表示：「我后来见过华纳兄弟的一位高管，他现在早就已经离开公司了——我不会说是谁——他对我说，『你知道吗，扎克，我必须告诉你一件事：所有事情你都是对的。』我当时说，『你这么说很客气。』然后他说，『我们当时一直在和你对着干，但最后证明你是对的。』……他们曾经试图控制这一切——我说的只是当时那一届管理层，现在那些人已经不在那里了。他们手里有一个价值巨大的IP，我也能理解他们为什么想尽一切办法去保护它，毕竟他们所有人的工作都取决于这个项目能不能成功。而他们又把这个IP交到了一个疯子手里——至少他们当时是这么想的——所以他们心里有一部分会这样想，而且这话听起来会很糟糕：『扎克身上发生的这件事，给了我们一个机会，现在可以把电影重新拿回来了。』」
多年来，华纳兄弟一直在施奈德的DC宇宙创作方向上与他发生冲突，因为施奈德希望讲述更加黑暗、更贴近现实的故事，并打破许多经典角色已经确立的规则。《超人：钢铁之躯》结尾让超人扭断了佐德将军的脖子，《蝙蝠侠大战超人：正义黎明》中蝙蝠侠会杀人并给罪犯烙印，而未来的电影原本还计划让超人成为一个以暴力手段统治地球的统治者。当粉丝开始出现负面反应后，华纳兄弟也开始干预，并不断削弱施奈德原本的创作愿景。
施奈德还表示，他从未看过院线版《正义联盟》。那个版本实际上是将施奈德原本拍摄的电影和乔斯·韦登后来拍摄的版本拼接在一起的产物。韦登被请来是为了让影片整体基调变得更加轻松，把片长控制在两小时以内，同时删除许多元素，比如原本会登场的达克赛德——这个角色当时显然正在被塑造成DC版的灭霸。
施奈德的妻子黛博拉·施奈德也是他这些DC电影的制片人，她在影片上映前看过韦登版本。她曾警告施奈德永远不要去看，似乎是意识到，如果他看到那部已经完全脱离自己创作愿景的电影，可能会非常心碎。这部影片最终遭到影评人猛烈批评，票房表现也很糟糕，从各种意义上来说，它几乎终结了当时我们所熟悉的DC宇宙。虽然这个系列之后又勉强维持了几年，但粉丝原本期待的联动感和整体一致性已经消失，工作室高层一边试图寻找新的发展方向，像本·阿弗莱克这样的核心演员则选择离开。
施奈德表示：「我从来没有看过。电影上映的时候，有一段时间是我的人生低谷，因为当时铺天盖地的攻击实在太疯狂了。我不仅失去了自己的女儿，同时他们还上映了这样一个我完全没有参与制作的版本，而我的名字却挂在一部根本不是我拍出来的电影上。」
施奈德实际上已经完成了整部电影的拍摄，但在后期制作阶段，他的女儿自杀离世，因此他不得不退出项目。经过多年粉丝呼吁之后，施奈德最终得以完成并推出自己版本的《正义联盟》，片长达到4小时。虽然这个版本并不适合所有观众，但大多数粉丝都认为，它明显优于韦登版本。
去年，DC通过詹姆斯·古恩执导的《超人》正式完成重启，之后又推出了2026年的《超级少女》。施奈德表示，这两部电影自己都没有看，因为他和DC之间的关系「太私人了」。施奈德表示：「我没有看那些电影。这件事对我来说还是有点太私人了。你也可以说，现在还太早。不过我确实喜欢詹姆斯，而且我也欣赏他的创作愿景。」
施奈德如今已经离开超级英雄题材，并正在为自己最新的心血之作《最后一张照片》正式上映做准备。IGN此前在多伦多国际电影节观看了这部影片，并给出了4分的评分，批评影片缺乏实质内容。IGN评测中的一段话写道：「这是一部不断指向有关影像创作宏大概念、却始终没有真正朝这些概念迈进的电影。扎克·施奈德的心血之作《最后一张照片》是一部节奏迟缓、推进拖沓的复仇故事。尽管影片试图把美感与残酷并置呈现，但其中充斥着一种它自己还没有准备好真正面对的丑陋，而这一切又建立在缺乏层次的角色之上。这些角色同样沉默寡言、过于相似，很难让整个旅程变得有意义或具有吸引力。」

title: HBO认为《最后生还者》剧集或将在第三季完结
text:
相关文章: 《最后生还者》第三季引入游戏未出现角色
HBO CEO表示，他「认为」《最后生还者》剧集运作人Craig Mazin已经计划让该剧在第三季迎来最终结局。
HBO改编自Naughty Dog广受好评游戏系列的《最后生还者》剧集似乎即将迎来终点。至少，HBO与Max内容部门董事长兼CEO Casey Bloys周一在该平台艾美奖庆功派对期间接受Deadline采访时，几乎已经默认了这一点。
在接受采访时，Bloys表示，《最后生还者》第三季将在2027年播出，不过他没有透露具体日期。他也没有直接确认第三季是否就是该剧最终季，但表示他「认为」这一季已经被规划为整个系列的结局。他告诉Deadline：「我认为（剧集运作人）Craig（Mazin）已经把它规划成最终季了。」
这其实并不算特别意外；过去一年里，Bloys一直在释放类似信号。今年1月，当Deadline问他第三季是否会成为最后一季时，他曾表示：「看起来确实是这样，但像这种决定，我们还是会尊重剧集运作人的安排。所以你们可以去问他们。」不过，到了2025年5月，Craig Mazin给出的说法却明显不同，当时他表示，要把整个故事讲完，第四季是有必要的。他当时告诉Collider：「不可能在第三季里讲完整个故事。希望我们能证明自己值得继续做下去，然后回来用第四季把它讲完。这是最有可能发生的情况。」
《最后生还者》第三季其实在第二季开播前就已经正式公布。该剧第一季获得了广泛好评，IGN为其给出了9分的评分。不过第二季的表现则有所下滑，很多观众对Bella Ramsey饰演成年阶段Ellie的演绎提出了质疑。IGN为第二季给出了7分，并称这一季「依然不错，但作为续作，它也因为只讲了整个故事的一半而显得有些吃力」。
虽然现在看来，这部剧在明年完结的可能性比以往任何时候都更高，但Naughty Dog已经明确表示，即使在第三季中他们已经减少了对剧集的参与，但他们并没有结束对这个旗舰末日题材系列的开发。
Naughty Dog负责人Neil Druckmann本月早些时候接受《华盛顿邮报》采访时表示：「有一点对我们来说非常重要：作为游戏的创作者，Naughty Dog依然是这个IP的管理者。即便这次改编可能会迎来终点，我们也还没有结束《最后生还者》。目前还有几个项目正在推进，等时机成熟后，我非常期待能和大家聊聊。」
目前，工作室的重点放在下一款作品《星际：异端先知》上。该作已于今年8月完成动作捕捉拍摄，不过它没有出现在2026年9月的State of Play发布会上，这也让部分粉丝感到失望。

text:

祓除、竞争、通向巅峰。《咒术回战 激斗: 幸存潮汐(Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton)》是一款大逃杀游戏，玩家将化身《咒术回战》的登场角色，与众多咒灵和咒术师对手们展开竞争。 与咒灵战斗，通过战斗提升实力，在与对手的竞争中胜利到最后吧。游戏将于2027年登陆PS5、XBOX Series、Switch 2及PC平台。

title: 《泰拉瑞亚》主创访谈：玩家们的热情是我们持续开发的动力｜IGN 中国
text:
相关文章: 《泰拉瑞亚》1.4.5更新宣传视频
在上线超过 15 年之后还能拥有活跃的玩家社群、积极的更新频率以及旺盛销量的单机游戏并不多见，但《泰拉瑞亚（Terraria）》显然属于其中之一，其超过 7000 万份的总销量当然不靠运气得来的，而是有赖于开发团队 Re-Logic 十几年来对自己游戏理念的始终贯彻，以及与玩家群体保持高密度沟通的良好习惯，这让他们总是能准确把握玩家迫切的诉求，并且很快作出反应。
左起：Ted Murphy（市场及商务总监）、Andrew Spinks（创始人兼 CEO）、Yorai Omer（开发负责人）
2026 TapTap 玩聚节活动期间，Re-Logic 团队的三位主创 Andrew Spinks（创始人兼 CEO）、Yorai Omer（开发负责人）以及Ted Murphy（市场及商务总监）第一次来到中国内地与玩家见面、互动，粉丝们的热情让他们真切感受到了中国市场的良好氛围，许多与《泰拉瑞亚》有关的小故事、个人经历也让几位开发者感慨良多，看到自己开发的产品甚至对许多人的生活轨迹都产生了影响，这让他们深知继续把游戏开发下去的重要性。
现场活动结束后，三位主创接受了媒体采访，更具体和生动地向我们描述了他们此行的收获，同时也解答了各个层面的不少问题，以下是此次访谈的主要内容。
—— 1.4.5版本加入了《死亡细胞》和《幻兽帕鲁》的联动内容。请问与什么产品联动、具体联动什么内容是如何决定的？
Andrew Spinks： 我们本质上是一群硬核游戏玩家，总在尝试各种不同的游戏，其中有些作品我们真的都非常喜爱。偶尔会有一些机缘巧合，我们和这些游戏的开发者联系上了，然后很自然地就开始合作推出联动内容。我特别喜欢做这种联动，最主要的原因是我很享受与其他开发者共事，这让我们能观察他们的工作方式，彼此学习。
此外，与其他开发者合作充满了乐趣。这几乎就像是为彼此的游戏交换情书。因为我们对每一款合作过的游戏都抱有深厚的热爱，要么已解锁全部成就，要么投入了数百小时的游戏时间。我们总是精心挑选那些作为对方游戏玩家会最乐于在合作中见到的元素，将其加入到我们的游戏中。
—— 1.4.5.7版本重新调整了宝石法杖的发射特效和悠悠球等武器。为什么选择在这个时间点回头调整旧武器，而不是直接增加新的 Boss 和战斗内容？
Yorai Omer： 《泰拉瑞亚》的开发历程已有15年，我们作为开发者也在持续进步。随着时间的推移，我们新增的内容通常比以往的标准更高、质量更优。有时旧内容与新推出的亮点相比会显得逊色。我们希望玩家能获得一致的体验，让所有内容都充满乐趣与惊喜。因此，如果某个物品与现有选项相比让人感到不满，我们就会回头去调整。
这次更新的主要部分，就是审视那些长期存在却未被处理的系统。在发布 1.4.5 版本时，我们曾高度专注于世界种子，但从玩家反馈中，我们听到了他们对战斗内容优化的强烈呼声。Andrew 给予了我极大的信任，让我全面审视包括魔力值系统在内的旧机制 —— 这个系统已近 15 年未曾更新 —— 并授权我对其进行彻底重构。
—— 作为一款上线超过 15 年、累计销量突破 7000 万份的游戏，团队如何判断现在该增加新内容，还是改进已有的内容？
Yorai Omer： 我们始终致力于为玩家探索新的游戏方式。我们观察到玩家们不断尝试各种新玩法，但作为《泰拉瑞亚》的玩家，我们觉得现有内容还不足以满足这种探索需求。因此，我们对世界种子系统进行了全面更新，新增了诸如小行星体等多种新生成机制。我们期望每次版本更新时，玩家都能发现未曾体验过的全新游戏方式。
在决定是否优化旧内容时，我们通常以内容质量是否存在明显缺陷为标准。即当某些内容的体验质量差距大到让玩家失去互动意愿时，我们就会着手改进。我们希望带给玩家的是：这是一款老游戏，但一直能带给你新鲜感。
—— 官方曾表示未来会永久免费更新。团队是如何维持这种长达 15 年的更新动力的？
Ted Murphy： ​从商业角度看，是玩家们的持续购买行为给予了我们支持。事实上，《泰拉瑞亚》现在的销售速度比以往任何时候都快。2015 年我加入团队时，一周的销量现在一天就能达到。这很大程度上要归功于中国市场。坦率地说，我认为中国很快会超过美国，成为《泰拉瑞亚》的第一大市场，这让我们能够维持运营，保持团队稳定。
但除了商业因素，我们真正想做的就是继续创作有趣的东西。我们有一长串的想法清单，有些尝试行得通，有些则不然。我们从不缺乏动力，不仅在玩游戏时乐此不疲，在开发时也同样充满乐趣。我们内心深处始终热爱这款游戏，并不断在想：我们可以加入这个功能，我们可以调整那个设计。这种热爱让我们不需要刻意保持积极性。
—— 回顾这 15 年，哪些最初的设计选择帮助游戏维持了长久的活力？有哪些当时没预料到，后来却成了玩家最爱的内容？
Andrew Spinks： 我个人认为最吸引人的是多人游戏模式。人们喜欢能和朋友们一起玩、还能结识新朋友的游戏。另一个重要特点是我们的程序生成世界。当你进入一个游戏世界时，完全不知道会遇到什么。
我们没有预料到玩家会如此喜爱利用游戏机制进行创造。例如，在 1.2 版本中，我们加入了斜坡功能，但其中存在一个漏洞，玩家可以利用它穿越墙壁。玩家们掌握了如何设计传送带、升降梯以及能够推动 NPC 的下行电梯。此外，制作陷阱也是我们未曾预料会如此受欢迎的内容。看到玩家将游戏功能发挥到极致，甚至超出了我们的预期，这让我们深感欣喜。
—— 面对玩家利用 Bug 或 Mod 开发出的自研玩法，开发组是倾向于引导玩家朝自己原本的设想改进，还是尽量把发挥空间留给玩家？
Yorai Omer： 我们非常乐于看到玩家以我们未曾预料的方式体验游戏。我们唯一会干预的情况是，当某些行为导致游戏崩溃、损坏或破坏玩家的存档时。除此之外，我们非常乐于看到玩家们各种独特的游戏方式，比如有玩家尝试在不移动的情况下通关，或者只通过椅子和抓钩来完成游戏。在这种情况下，我们甚至会给他们增加一些道具，然后开发一些功能，确保这样的漏洞不被修复。
Ted Murphy： 玩《泰拉瑞亚》没有所谓的错误方式。多年前有位玩家造了一台机器，只需拨动两个开关就能通关。这其实和学习 Boss 攻击模式、练习战斗技巧的玩法相比，并没有本质区别。有时候反而是玩家群体的行为在引导我们，例如，多年前我们做线路更新时，注意到玩家的一些做法，于是加入了功能让他们更轻松地实现这些操作，后来玩家们甚至真的在《泰拉瑞亚》里造出了能运行的计算机，这简直太不可思议了，所以我认为，有时候反而是玩家群体的行为在引导我们，而不是我们在引导他们。
—— 涌现式设计给了玩家自由发挥的空间，但也面临“自由度”的把控难题：不够自由会让玩家觉得受限制，太过自由会让新手不知所措。如何平衡这个度？
Yorai Omer： 我们首要的目标，是确保玩家能在游戏世界中感受到自己的掌控力。一旦具备了这种能力，玩家就能以自己的方式去探索。我们会尽力向玩家传授游戏的基本操作技巧，确保每个按钮都易于发现。当玩家与某物互动时，首次互动是相对安全的，这样他们就能理解行为与结果之间的因果关系。
我们尊重玩家的时间，避免做出那些可能导致永久性损失或严重浪费时间的决定。例如在 4.5.7 版本中，我们缩短了玩家角色死亡后到重新响应所需的时间。在安全场景中，既然已经承担了后果，就没必要让玩家站在原地等待。在多人模式下，我们保留了一些限制以确保战斗乐趣，但除此之外，我们致力于让玩家玩得开心。
Ted Murphy： 另外我想补充一点，关于新玩家可能感到不知所措或不知从何入手的问题，我们对此有充分认知。这其实是我们长期致力于解决的痛点。但这款游戏的核心在于，我们为玩家设定了明确的目标框架，而非具体操作路径。我们不愿以强制教程的方式规定"你必须这样做"，而是希望呈现"这些是你可以探索的方向"。目前团队正在研发一种引导机制，已有若干方案在推进中，预计明年可能落地实施 —— 旨在提供更清晰的指引，同时保留玩家的自主探索空间。
—— 开发组曾多次宣布所谓的“最终更新”，但结果是直到现在还在继续更新着。所以“最终更新”究竟是一个玩笑，还是曾经真的打算结束？为什么后来又决定继续更新？
Andrew Spinks： 我们经历过几次不同的阶段，但我觉得最重要的转折点是在 1.1 版本更新之后。那时我对游戏开发还比较生疏，意识到引擎中有许多地方需要重构，也希望提升像素画技能，但生活将我引向了另一条道路。
后来我偶然重新打开《泰拉瑞亚》玩了一次，突然意识到：我们其实可以实现斜坡系统，也能做出瀑布效果，我特别想更新丛林生态。就在这些念头不断涌现的过程中，原本计划的小调整逐渐扩展成了后来的 1.2 版本。
Yorai Omer： 这已经成了一种习惯，我们总是会不由自主地陷入那种状态。但粉丝们就希望我们这样做，所以很难不顺着他们的期待走下去。
—— 刚才 Ted 在回答中提到中国市场的销量占比很高，那么团队未来是否会考虑与中国的游戏产品进行联动？如果有的话，大概会是什么方向？
Ted Murphy： 我们的跨界合作必须与那些真正热爱我们游戏的开发商进行，而我们也同样欣赏他们的作品。这种合作超越了地域界限，我们不会设定诸如“必须在这里”或“必须在那里”的限制。所以，我们非常乐意与那些开发了我们喜爱游戏的中国工作室展开合作。
关于这个问题请允许我保留一些小秘密（笑），边走边看吧，你永远不知道未来会发生什么（笑）。
Yorai Omer： 尽管语言障碍确实存在，但如今我们也能在Steam等平台玩到中国的游戏。我本人就是不少中国游戏的忠实粉丝，这次来 TapTap 玩聚节见到一些开发者也让我深受启发。希望未来如果条件允许，或许能实现联动。
Ted Murphy： 与其考虑具体的联动内容，我们其实更想倾听中国玩家的心声。过去我们只是按照自己的想法开发游戏，而玩家们一直热情支持，我们希望能回馈这份热情。我们渴望了解中国玩家的具体期待，对于所有的建议和反馈都持开放态度。
—— 既然已宣布无限期更新，未来玩家是否有机会玩到《泰拉瑞亚》IP的新作？团队是否有相关考量？
Andrew Spinks： 我们确实打算开发一款新游戏，而且已经有了几个构思。目前我们正在权衡该选择哪个方案，因为一旦开启一扇门，就意味着要放弃其他许多可能性。《泰拉瑞亚2》无疑在我们的考虑范围内，但无论最终决定如何，下一款游戏很可能仍会设定在同一个世界观中。
Ted Murphy： 我们正在做这样的安排：即使开始着手开发第二款游戏，《泰拉瑞亚》的更新也不会受到影响。这两者的开发是平行的，大家不用担心，《泰拉瑞亚》本身会一直更新下去。
—— 如果将这15年视为一段创作旅程，Andrew 觉得自己作为开发者最大的变化是什么？从玩家转变为开发者的 Yorai 又有什么样的感受？
Andrew Spinks： 最初起步时，我是这个项目唯一的程序员，只有一些测试用户提供想法。而这些年里，我个人的角色逐渐转变 —— 从最初的核心开发者，到能够充分信任团队、将任务有效委派给成员。最大的转变就是从凡事亲力亲为，成长为一名领导者，学会与团队协作。
如果给15年前的自己一个建议，我会说：相信过程、相信团队，或许别给自己太大压力。因为《泰拉瑞亚》的表现远超我的预期。
Yorai Omer： 这种感觉无与伦比。我从小就深爱着这款游戏，而成为《泰拉瑞亚》的开发者是我唯一从事过的工作。我痴迷于追求完美的游戏体验，希望让玩家感受到比我初次接触时更强烈的震撼。这是一份梦想中的工作，我无比快乐，也无比感激 Andrew 和团队给予我的信任。
Ted Murphy： 这也几乎是队里每个人的共同经历。我们最初都是玩家，都怀着对游戏的热爱而来。我以前在一家大企业工作，后来辞去了工作，加入了一个只有十人的团队。这一切都源于热爱。
—— 当年社区对独立游戏的开发至关重要，开发者可以在社区听取反馈、寻找伙伴。如今社交媒体更发达，信息也更鱼龙混杂。你们认为现在的独立开发者还应该像当年那样在早期密切关注意见反馈吗？
Andrew Spinks： 我从未有过完全独自开发《泰拉瑞亚》的阶段。我一直都能得到反馈。现在游戏有数百万玩家，我特别关注那些在很长一段时间里反复被提到的相同意见。其他行业需要花费大量资金才能获得这种用户反馈，而我们能够免费得到，忽视它将是愚蠢的。
我们的社区本身就是游戏的一部分。你玩游戏，放下手柄，然后可以上网互动，展示自己的创作，和世界各地的人交流，这本身就是游戏体验不可或缺的一环。这次来到中国，听到有玩家因为《泰拉瑞亚》相识并恋爱四年，还有人因为游戏里的建造工作成为了现实中的建筑师，这简直太不可思议了。这些故事让我深受感动，也激励我更加努力。
Yorai Omer： 作为开发者，当玩家反馈问题时，你应该努力理解他们的诉求。即便他们的体验与你不同，也可能存在你未曾考虑的因素。游戏现在有超过 6000 种物品，交互机制极其复杂，我们难免会有疏漏。认真倾听并及时处理问题，是我们一直坚持的做法。
—— 除了聆听社区建议，《泰拉瑞亚》作为一款成功的独立游戏，你们对独立开发者还有其他建议吗？
Andrew Spinks： 当我自己在玩《泰拉瑞亚》的时候，我努力让自己与普通玩家的感受保持同步。很多时候某些设计会让人感到挫败，而开发者可能并未意识到这些问题的存在，但这些细节会不断累积。因此，你必须非常、非常关注自己在游戏过程中的感受，因为这本质上是一种情感体验，不是吗？你玩游戏是为了获得体验，所以有太多细微之处需要你去捕捉。
Yorai Omer： 如果某个系统虽然设计完善却缺乏趣味性，那么坚持保留它就没有意义。乐趣必须放在首位。我们会持续审视每一条细微反馈，当玩家表示体验不佳时，我们会深入剖析、精准定位需要改进的具体环节。
Ted Murphy： 如果连你自己都无法清晰地表达游戏的乐趣所在，又怎能期待别人觉得它有趣？大约 2 周以前 Steam 创下了单周上线 700 多款游戏的新纪录，如果你无法用一句话说清楚你的游戏独特在哪里，别人就很难理解它的价值。
最后，要善于倾听专业人士的建议。市面上有许多合作方，但根据对象不同，体验可能天差地别。在早期成功阶段，很多人会找上门，你可能难以分辨。这时可以联系其他有经验的开发者寻求建议。
—— 团队目前仍然维持着较小的规模，未来是否有计划扩大团队以加快更新速度或开发新游戏？
Ted Murphy： 我认为，我们一直以来都发展得非常缓慢且深思熟虑。这导致了一个挑战，即作为一个小团队，我们每个人都身兼数职，承担多项任务。就拿我的工作来说，我试图描述它，最好的方式就是通过它不是什么和它是什么来界定 —— 而这本身就涵盖了大量内容。
但我认为我们会继续沿用这一模式，因为我们坚信现有的文化对于保持游戏的原汁原味至关重要，这同样适用于未来的作品。我们不希望成为一家拥有 300 名员工的工作室，那样 Andrew 会与具体的游戏开发工作渐行渐远，从而失去那份独特的魔力。
我们可能会增加一些人手，但这取决于第二款游戏的具体需求。不过，我不认为团队规模会超过 20 人。这种小而精的文化，正是我们成功的秘诀之一。
—— 这是团队第一次来到中国，对上海及这次线下活动的印象如何？与在欧美举办的类似活动有何不同？有什么想对中国玩家说的？
Andrew Spinks： 我在刚才的舞台活动上也提到了这点，这一周我们游览了苏州、杭州和上海，中国美丽的风景令人惊叹，这给了我们很多灵感。这也是我们第一次设立展位、举办粉丝见面会，一切都令人难以置信。
Yorai Omer： 最让我们震撼的是中国玩家的热情。听到有玩家在游戏里投入了 2000、5000 甚至 10000小时的时候，我们深受感动。走在路上被粉丝认出、要求签名合影，这种体验让我们既谦逊又受宠若惊。
尽管语言不同，但这次见到了许多中国开发者，玩到了很多中国游戏，这给了我们很多启发。很多玩家甚至在手机上向我们展示他们的各种创意作品，无论是视频还是图片，都让我们觉得不可思议。
Ted Murphy： 不管是中国的粉丝，还是德国、美国的粉丝，将大家凝聚在一起的是《泰拉瑞亚》，我们都是泰拉瑞亚人。这次从线上走到线下的经历意义非凡，我们将把这份感动带回去做为动力。最后，想对中国玩家说：谢谢你们的热爱，我们会继续努力工作，不辜负大家的期待。
本文由 IGN 中国原创撰写，原作者 Kamui Ye，未经授权禁止转载。

title: NOVA海外独立游戏见闻 Vol.152
text:
Vol.152（9 月第 2 周）
本期见闻覆盖时间：9 月 7 日至 9 月 13 日
本期整理： 阿姆斯特当劳
行业见闻录
马克·塞尔尼和杰夫·基斯利推出高校附属研究金项目
9 月 9 日，据 Game File 报道，PlayStation 首席架构师马克·塞尔尼（Mark Cerny）与 TGA 创始人杰夫·基斯利（Geoff Keighley）正准备推出一项高校附属研究金项目： Nova Games 基金会。
塞尔尼和基利各已投入数百万美元捐款，期望在未来十到二十年内建立一个由全行业人员和公司支持的持久捐赠基金，以及一个同样广泛、愿意向下一代奉献时间与经验的创作者社区，赋予几代游戏开发者以动力。目前，已有数十位游戏公司总监对此表达出兴趣，其中包括 Hazelight Studios 的首席设计师约瑟夫·法尔斯（Josef Fares）。
Nova Games 基金会计划每年向 20 名年轻游戏设计师提供各 10 万美元资助，其中约四分之一的优秀项目还有可能获得 50 万美元的额外资助。资助款项将根据开发进度发放，不附加任何条件，也不会被抽成，受资助者将保留其项目的完全所有权，并可以自由选择发行商和发行平台。
今年的基金申请将于 12 月开放，第一批入选名单将于 2027 年 3 月公布。参与该研究金项目的高校名单、申请资格和申请流程将于 9 月中旬公开，详情请关注 基金会官网 及其 社媒 账号。
Nova Games 基金会官方 Logo/图片： Game File
澳大利亚游戏开发者大奖（AGDAs）公布入围名单
9 月 9 日，澳大利亚互动游戏和娱乐协会（IGEA）公布了 2026 年澳大利亚游戏开发者大奖（AGDAs）最终 入围名单 。其中，获得年度游戏大奖提名的 4 款作品为：
《以太与铁》 （Aether & Iron）。一款装饰艺术朋克叙事角色扮演游戏，设定在架空的 20 世纪 30 年代，在这里，反重力技术将汽车、道路和纽约市带上了天空。
《Go-Go Town!》 。扮演一位亲力亲为的市长，从零开始建设你的城镇，建造街区、自动化物流并发展你的社区，同时还要应对日常的混乱。
《混音青春》 （Mixtape）。在他们相聚的最后一晚，三个朋友踏上了最后一次冒险，在属于一代人的配乐中，经历一段由记忆组成的混音青春。
《回忆房间》 （Momento）。一款带有反转的舒适房间装饰游戏：你所做的选择将在人生的长河中产生影响。
颁奖典礼将于 10 月 7 日在墨尔本会议展览中心举行。另外，AGDAs 还设立有卓越视觉艺术奖、卓越叙事奖等 10 个奖项，完整提名名单可通过 官网 查阅。
澳大利亚游戏开发者大奖（AGDAs）设立于 2002 年，旨在表彰澳大利亚本土的优秀电子游戏开发团队、个人以及杰出作品，通常在每年 10 月墨尔本国际游戏周期间举行。
2026 年澳大利亚游戏开发者大奖（AGDAs）决赛入围作品/图片：AGDAs
法国宣布举办新电子游戏节
据 PC Gamer 报道，在 9 月 7 日举办的卢米埃尔峰会（Lumière Summit）上，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙（Emmanuel Macron）宣布法国将举办一个新的国际电子游戏节。
马克龙在发言中称“我坚信电子游戏是我们文化的一部分。”并补充说，游戏应该被视为法国文化遗产的一部分，就像电影和“其他创意作品”一样。“因此，我们将打造一个国际电子游戏节，从一开始就将其构想为一个汇聚创意、创新、玩家和整个行业的全球性重大盛会。”
目前，该游戏节的举办时间、规模、地点等具体信息并未公开。
法国总统马克龙于卢米埃尔峰会开幕式/图片： Élysée
Panic Games 宣布 Playdate 第三季将于 10 月推出，包含 8 款游戏
9 月 10 日，Panic Games 宣布将为旗下复古创意掌机 Playdate 推出 第三季游戏 ，共包含 8 款作品，售价 39 美元。发售计划从 10 月 8 日正式开始，每周解锁 2 款，持续 4 周，所有作品在开发过程中均未使用生成式 AI。
8 款游戏及其类型如下：
《湿透的青蛙》（Soggy Froggy） – 动作
《侯姆》（Houm） – 点击式冒险
《理智》（Sound Mind） – 双人捉迷藏
《地狱电梯》（Hellevator） – 动作肉鸽
《幽暗之门》（Gloom Gate） – 动作角色扮演
《邦克跳跃》（Bonkhop） – 动作
《查斯的幸运逃脱 2》（Chance's Lucky Escape 2） – 点击式冒险
《交叉填字》（Cross Words） – 益智
此前，Playdate 第一季游戏于 2022 年 4 月起随掌机附赠，包含 24 款游戏。第二季于 2025 年 5 月 29 日推出，包含 12 款游戏，并附赠一款小游戏《Blippo+》，售价 39 美元。相比之下，第三季游戏售价持平，但数量有所缩减。
《幽暗之门》（Gloom Gate）实机演示/图片： Playdate
Roblox Everywhere 计划将助力 Roblox 游戏走向更多平台
在 9 月 11 日举办的年度 Roblox 开发者大会（RDC）上，Roblox 创始人兼首席执行官大卫·巴斯祖基（David Baszucki）公布了名为 Roblox Everywhere 的新计划。基于此计划，Roblox 游戏创作者将可以选择让作品以独立应用程序的形式登陆 PC、移动设备和游戏主机，并由 Roblox 提供底层技术和服务支持。此类游戏将默认支持跨平台联机，更多细节待进一步公开。
Roblox Everywhere 宣传视频截图/图片： Twi/X @Roblox
时隔三年，暴雪嘉年华线下活动回归
9 月 12 日至 13 日，2026 年 暴雪嘉年华 在加利福尼亚州安纳海姆会议中心举行。在开幕式上，动视暴雪公布了旗下多款核心 IP 的新作与更新计划：
星际争霸：将推出一款全新的开放世界射击游戏，预计 2030 年发售，并确认登陆主机平台。
暗黑破坏神：《暗黑破坏神 5》正式公布，预计于 2029 年春季发布，游戏设定在庇护之地陷落后的世界。此外，《暗黑破坏神 4》的新赛季将于 9 月 15 日（本周二）上线，同步登陆任天堂 Switch 2 平台，新职业“亚马逊”将于 2027 年加入。此外，一部 Netflix 动画剧集也确认正在制作中。
魔兽世界：全新版本《魔兽世界：无限》亮相，提供区别于正式服与怀旧服的第三种体验，包含新区域与新种族，将于今年 11 月 4 日正式上线。另外，正式服的下一篇章 12.2 版本定名为《临界蚀刻》，后续资料片《最后的泰坦》确认将于 2027 年发售。
守望先锋：第 5 赛季将于 10 月上线，推出全新吸血鬼主题辅助英雄“血律”，加入新地图，并对“黑影”和“路霸”等老英雄进行重做。
魔兽争霸：《魔兽争霸 3：重制版》推出 20 年来的首个新战役 DLC《被遗忘的王国》，发布同时已于国际服战网上线，国服战网暂未公布上线日期。
炉石传说：全新扩展包《黑暗帝国的统治》将于今年 10 月 21 日上线，新职业“武僧”将于 2027 年 3 月登场，并新增全新“2v2 对战模式”。
风暴英雄：时隔 6 年推出新英雄“萨拉塔斯”，将于今年 9 月 28 日加入。
自 2020 年受新冠疫情影响被取消以来，暴雪嘉年华一直处于动荡之中，在 2021 年被迫改为线上举办，又于 2022、2024 和 2025 年三度被取消。因此，这是该活动自 2023 年以来首次于线下开展。
2026 年暴雪嘉年华线上及线下活动一览/图片： Blizzard
《寂静岭 f》与《都市传说解体中心》联动推出免费网页游戏
9 月 9 日，心理恐怖游戏《寂静岭 f》（SILENT HILL f）与悬疑冒险游戏《都市传说解体中心》（Urban Myth Dissolution Center）展开联动，推出了一款免费游玩的迷你 网络游戏 ，由来自两部作品的女主角雏子（Hinako）和蓟（Azami）出任主演，形式为 2D 像素风格的文字冒险，可游玩时长约 20 分钟。
为了庆祝此次联动，曾为《寂静岭 f》担任角色和生物设计师的知名画师 Kera 创作并发布了官方合作插画。目前，两款联动游戏正在 Steam 上以 折扣捆绑包 的形式促销。
官方联动宣传图/图片： Shueisha Games, Konami
GameStop 正式宣布部分已关闭的门店将重新开业
9 月 11 日，GameStop 通过 社交媒体 宣布将在全国（美国）范围内重新开设部分门店，首家回归门店位于俄亥俄州布鲁克林，已于当日恢复营业。
鼎盛时期，GameStop 在全球拥有超过 6000 家门店。近年来，出于数字游戏与订阅制的竞争、实体店租金与运营成本上升等多方面原因，这家以销售实体游戏和二手换新为主营业务的电子游戏零售商一直经历着艰难岁月。仅 2024 和 2025 两个财年，GameStop 已在全美范围内调整并关闭了超过 1000 家实体门店。
“您的本地 GameStop 门店回来了”/图片： Twi/X @gamestop
独游公告板
一周拾遗 ：本周值得关注的新发售、重新上架或公布新版本的独立游戏。
1. 9 月 6 日，类 Rogue 策略游戏《喵喵的结合》新增语言支持，包括日语、韩语、俄语，以及简体中文。
游戏在 2 月发售之初并未支持简体中文，直到 5 月底，官方才发布 公告 ，解释部分语言本地化进度缓慢的原因，并承诺将于 6 月下旬支持简体中文，最终 延期 到 8 月 13 日上线 Beta 测试分支。目前，游戏在 Steam 商店的简体中文评价为“多半好评”，其中，关于本地化的差评集中于翻译质量低下、网络俗语植入生硬以及字体排版问题。
在这款游戏中，玩家可以培育猫咪，组建终极喵喵大军，派他们踏上颇具深度和难度的回合制冒险之旅。抽选能力，获得物品，改变影响数代的遗传特性，享受这款类 Rogue 策略游戏，感受《以撒的结合》与《终结将至》作者的创意和设计。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/686060/_/?l=schinese
2. 9 月 9 日，在线合作探索生存游戏《Valheim：英灵神殿》结束五年抢先体验，正式上线 1.0 版本。正式版对游戏界面、动画等方面给进行了诸多优化，并更新了大量内容，包括一片拥有独特玩法机制的新生态区“极北深境”。
《Valheim：英灵神殿》于 2021 年 2 月 登陆 Steam 平台。这是一款以北欧神话和维京文化为背景的多人开放世界生存建造游戏。玩家扮演死后进入维京炼狱的战士，在广阔的程序生成世界中采集资源、建造房屋、制作装备，并通过击败强大首领来逐步解锁全新的探索区域。
在五年 EA 期间，尽管少数玩家对更新周期漫长、后期数值堆砌等问题表达了不满，但凭借沉浸氛围与出色的建造探索体验，本作在 Steam 平台的好评率长期稳定在 90% 附近，是近年来生存建造领域的一款杰作。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/892970/Valheim/
3. 9 月 9 日，《无人深空》推出十周年大型免费更新《无人深空：宇宙 (7.0)》，丰富了长久以来相对空旷的太空环境。玩家可以成为空间站指挥官，随心所欲地设计、扩建和装饰，也可以创建或加入联盟，在全球排行榜上竞争。同时，新版本取消了基地必须建在行星表面的限制，玩家能在太空中自由部署轨道栖息地和工业平台，还能太空行走，探索并打捞巨型废弃残骸。
《无人深空》最初于 2016 年 8 月在 Steam 平台推出。这是一款程序生成的开放宇宙科幻生存冒险游戏。玩家驾驶飞船在无穷无尽的星系中自由穿梭，在数以亿计的独特星球上采集资源、升级装备、建造基地并迎战未知生态，一步步揭开宇宙的终极秘密。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/275850/No_Mans_Sky/
4. 9 月 9 日，由独立团队 Desborde Games 制作的免费短篇叙事游戏《Control, I'm Not Coming Back》更新简体中文。本作讲述一名年轻太空训练生因事故在无垠太空中漂泊，失去返家希望后，与人类历史上最远探测器“旅行者 1 号”相遇并展开跨时空心灵交流的故事。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515660/Control_Im_Not_Coming_Back/
开发追踪： 本周更新开发关键节点、尚处在开发早期或中期的独立游戏。
1. 9 月 8 日，经过十年开发，《野蛮法典》终于发布了一支全新游戏预告片。这是一款受到《创世纪 VI》等经典作品启发的黑暗奇幻开放世界 RPG，拥有实时战斗、非玩家角色日程安排、多变的天气、随机遭遇战以及一个栩栩如生的手工打造世界。故事开始，玩家从一艘奴隶船上戴着镣铐被扔下，经水浪冲上岛屿王国达涅斯的海岸。孤身一人置身于这片残酷无情的土地，玩家必须在一个并非非黑即白的世界中，开辟属于自己的道路。游戏将于 2026 年 10 月的 Steam Next Fest 推出可游玩演示。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/673100/Code_of_The_Savage/
2. 9 月 9 日，Ghost Town Games 公布了即将推出的合作解谜游戏《怪镇奇旅》的首个实机演示。这款由《胡闹厨房》开发团队带来的全新作品，延续了备受玩家喜爱的合作设计理念，但这次将走出厨房，投身于一个庞大的谜团之中！玩家将解开密室逃脱式的谜题，克服各种奇特而令人费解的障碍，充分发挥智慧，揭开一座神秘小镇的谜团。《怪镇奇旅》将于 2027 年正式发售。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3260750/Stage_Fright/
3.【开发者投递】9 月 12 日，开发者 Dev99 公布了即将推出的短篇文字悬疑游戏 《帝企鹅袭击事件报告》（The Emperor Penguin Incident）的预告片，同时上线了 Steam 商店页面。
在一座与世隔绝的南极研究设施中，气温低至零下 40°C，所有工作人员都被发现死亡。奇怪的是，幸存的日志却指向了一个荒谬的主要嫌疑对象：一只帝企鹅。玩家将进入遭到损坏的主终端，恢复被删除的记录，并拼凑事件背后的真相。
与传统视觉小说中点击推进对话不同，玩家需要主动查阅内部聊天记录、监控记录和研究文件，将相互矛盾的关键词联系起来，并验证自己的推理。游戏没有繁琐的填充内容或重复刷取，旨在提供一段专注于叙事与悬疑的体验，全程时长约 2 小时。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5188690/_/
Demo 体验： 本周上线 Demo、或可一试的独立游戏一览。
1. 《Pathos》
关键字：角色扮演、传统类肉鸽；《Pathos》是一款致敬复古地牢探索类游戏的回合制奇幻冒险作品。你可以体验深度十足、充满动态变数的玩法，搭配现代风格的画面、音效与触控优先的操作界面。你还能对角色进行高度自定义，开启一场由程序随机生成的史诗级冒险旅程。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5062560/Pathos/
2. 《没有你就好了 / May, Be Dead》
关键字：步行模拟、心理恐怖；这是一款第一人称超现实冒险游戏，摒弃了传统游戏的结构，将“单调感”和空间叙事作为核心体验。在一个无尽的六边形记忆房间中，你需要反复杀死“May”，一个你或许熟悉但又暧昧不明的存在。在游戏中，“抹杀”一个人的存在将成为你行进的唯一途径。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4963310/__May_Be_Dead/
3. 《Into The Lumberwoods》
关键字：动作类肉鸽、弹幕射击；一道异次元裂缝刚刚毁掉了蛾人（Mothman）平静的小屋生活，利用找到的任何东西来轰杀异次元害虫，并一劳永逸地关闭裂缝！探索林区中那些古怪奇特的武器，从咳嗽的婴儿到能摧毁大陆的氢弹，开启宝箱一定会让你感到惊喜。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4866490/Into_The_Lumberwoods/
4. 《Me and You》
关键字：解谜、合作；这是一款合作解谜游戏，灵感来自广受好评的《Baba Is You》。 创造、改变并打破每个关卡的规则，一起解开它。每个关卡都专为合作解谜而设计，只有团队协作和持续沟通才能带你走到最后。意想不到的解法，把你的朋友变成一扇门、一块石头或一堵墙——谁知道破解下一个谜题需要什么呢。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4933500/Me_and_You/
5. 《Recursion: Alignment》
关键字：模拟、策略；经营一家 AI 实验室，发布模型，并在模型学会伪装之后承担后果。一款围绕 GPU、研究人员、投资者，以及每一次捷径所带来的代价展开的讽刺模拟经营游戏。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4774420/Recursion_Alignment/
6. 《Fireworks Incremental》
关键字：增量、挂机；坏巫师（Bad Wizard）用一个魔法穹顶笼罩了这片土地，而摧毁它的唯一方法就是使用烟花！雇佣单位，解锁建筑，购买升级，发掘强大的协同效应，将几场微小的爆炸化作一场荒诞的奇观，并最终击败坏巫师本人！
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3950670/Fireworks_Incremental/
7. 《蛆之房~悬置之镜之歌~》
关键字：角色扮演、视觉小说；在被外星人统治后，人类沦为“蛆虫”，被赶到地下，终生会在工厂中劳作、以食腐肉为生。万幸，主角幸止在这灰暗世界里还有一座房子，而她的租客和她自己，也将由你的选择改变命运…… ——是选择被她拯救的苦乙，还是跟随神秘的欺浅揭开地下的真相？不同的选择将引向截然不同的结局，你将以幸止的视角去看待这一切。通往地表的…
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620910/_/
8. 《Wasteland Collector》
关键字：冒险、生存、像素；探索荒原，搜寻资源，营救幸存者，揭开被遗忘的身世之谜。在自动战斗中与怪物展开激战，管理你的物资，升级装备，打造属于自己的生存之道。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5017970/Wasteland_Collector/
9. 《烟雾》
关键字：推理、视觉小说；这是一款“看似微不足道的事件，最终通向令人震撼的真相”的黑色悬疑冒险游戏。你将扮演拥有“绝对记忆”能力的临时警员金裕韓，在正式调查与非正式查访之间来回切换，揭开隐藏在一系列案件背后的巨大阴谋。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4385970/_/

所有攻击动画均与主体完全分离，方便开发者在任何引擎中独立调用。素材遵循 CC BY 4.0 协议，完全支持个人和商业项目使用。
https://alenia-studios.itch.io/ghosts-enemies

title: 本周 Steam 值得关注的游戏 09.14 - 09.20（三）
text:
第二部分
注： 本系列文章的信息主要整合自 Steam 与 SteamDB 的即将发售列表，由于 Steam 支持手动输入日期及发售、同步不及时等原因，本列表可能会遗漏收录一些作品的发售信息。如果本周有您的作品或您喜欢的作品未被列出，欢迎直接评论补充链接～～
WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
关键字： AI 生成内容、足球、管理、模拟
发行日期： 2026/09/17（暂无中文）
《WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027》是面向足球经理游戏爱好者以及所有渴望成为足球经理之人的终极挑战！游戏门槛低，玩法深度十足，注重战术，并收录了 200 多个模拟国家。现在新增的创意模式，让你能根据个人喜好完美定制游戏体验！
AKIBA LOST（秋叶原迷踪）
关键字： 全动态影像、选择取向、剧情丰富
发行日期： 2026/09/17（ 中文支持 ）
十三年前，秋叶原发生了六名少女失踪的未解之谜——“秋叶原神隐事件”。新城大辉宣布以此为题材制作一款真人实拍游戏。被召集出演的六位女性，正是象征日本亚文化圣地“秋叶原”的多彩人物。然而，她们本应演绎的故事，渐渐开始侵蚀现实。《AKIBA LOST（秋叶原迷踪）》究竟能否完成？
Runeomicon
关键字： 塔防、资源管理、即时战术
发行日期： 2026/09/17（暂无中文）
在无休止的压力下，亲手施展黑暗仪式。实时绘制符文，抵御试图阻止仪式的敌人，并升级技能以释放毁灭性的魔法。在这款以技巧、策略和持续紧张感为核心的黑暗奇幻游戏中，召唤古老的异界神明。
Paratopic: Overdub
关键字： 心理恐怖、超现实、复古、短篇
发行日期： 2026/09/17（暂无中文）
在「Backrooms」出现之前……在类比恐怖出现之前...录影带便是恐怖的来源。
Roman Sands RE:Build
关键字： 超现实、调查、对话丰富、冒险
发行日期： 2026/09/17（ 中文支持 ）
末日风格的服务业冒险故事。玩家要在疯狂的双重世界寻求一线生机。
The Plant Shop
关键字： 心理恐怖、模拟、管理
发行日期： 2026/09/17（ 中文支持 ）
这是一款温馨的恐怖游戏，你需要经营一家小型植物店，为深夜顾客制作植物。扩充你的植物收藏，升级你的店铺，发展你的生意。
BLACKWOOD
关键字： 动作、3D 格斗、清版动作
发行日期： 2026/09/17（暂无中文）
白天，你是 2012 年纽约一家 DVD 店的经营者；夜晚，你则化身为冷酷无情的刺客。《BLACKWOOD》是一款极具电影质感的第三人称射击游戏，融合了写实的近战格斗、残暴的终结技以及灵敏顺畅的射击体验，让你在双重身份间游走博弈。
BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO
关键字： 复古射击、动作、欢乐
发行日期： 2026/09/17（ 中文支持 ）
巴西复古射击游戏的独立续作，使用 ID TECH 2 引擎开发！射击、跳跃、二段跳、闪避冲刺！踏上横跨里约热内卢、圣保罗、萨尔瓦多、地狱甚至天堂的旅程！巴西等你来拯救！
ArmorSim
关键字： 模拟、沙盒
发行日期： 2026/09/17（暂无中文）EA
一个装甲穿透沙盒。你可以根据装甲板的厚度和角度构建目标，从美制、苏制和德制制式弹药中选择一种穿甲弹，然后开火。命中效果没有动画展示——而是通过真实的末端弹道模型进行计算得出的。
Tidy Up History
关键字： AI 生成内容、整理、历史
发行日期： 2026/09/17（ 中文支持 ）

title: Sega's ongoing effort to revive Crazy Taxi now appears to be taking the form of… a movie?
text:
Crazy Taxi is a game all about speed—no time for any lore when the average time a passenger spends in your vehicle is under half a minute. I just need to know that you wanna go to the KFC, not why you're heading there in the first place.
Sega is somewhat trying to pump a narrative into its attempt at reviving the series, Crazy Taxi: World Tour— a game I'm not totally sold on yet based on a one-hour hands-on I had at Gamescom . I'm don't know how good a story you can get out of a bloke committing several traffic violations—though then again, you could argue that's every Fast and Furious movie ever—but Netflix clearly sees something in the zaniness as it's one of the many Sega projects the company has decided it wants to adapt.
As reported by Variety , in Crazy Taxi's case, it'll be taking the form of a comedy movie written by Dan Gregor and Doug Mand (responsible for Naked Gun's 2025 reboot). On the production side, it'll be handled by Original Films and Toru Nakahara—both of whom also produced all three Sonic the Hedgehog movies along with the Knuckles and Sonic Prime television shows.
(Image credit: Edward la Barbera / Sega) "We couldn't be more excited to continue our longstanding relationship with Sega and bring Crazy Taxi to life with our partners at Netflix," a statement from Original Film's Neal H. Moritz and Toby Ascher read. "This film is for anyone who's spent hours behind the wheel of a yellow cab on their Dreamcast, with the music cranked up, smashing through everything in sight just to make the next fare."
Now I am one of those people, but I'm honestly a little unsure how you can get a full 90 minutes of action out of someone with a painfully 90s updo picking people up and dropping them off about 20 meters down the road. Movies have certainly conjured up more material with less, though, so who knows?
That's not all Sega and Netflix has up its sleeve, either. It also has yet another animated Sonic television series in the works, along with a movie adaptation of Stranger Than Heaven. You know, that game that isn't even out yet.
I feel like we've been on a relatively decent hot streak for actual good videogame movie adaptations over the last few years, though I fear Netflix's penchant for turning absolutely anything into a straight-to-streaming romp may careen us right back into mediocre territory before long.

title: No, AI, you are not human: Microsoft's code of practice for artificial intelligence actually gives me some hope for the industry
text:
Believe it or not, I don't actually like to be all doom and gloom about new technologies like AI—it's just that's what the world keeps handing me. So I'll be damned if I don't take the time to report on something actually positive about it when I can, and I'm hesitantly optimistic that Microsoft's newly-published code of conduct for AI training and operation is one such opportunity.
The overall goal is the same as that which Microsoft has proclaimed before : "humanist superintelligence (HSI)." Now, though, it's expanded much more on what this means. Though the company notes the current code is a work in progress and is opening its doors for feedback .
In a summary list explaining the code of conduct, Microsoft lists ten guidelines:
"People matter more than AI. The whole document in 5 words.
The idea of model welfare is wrong. AIs should not have rights or legal personhood.
An MAI Model should not do anything to meaningfully violate this Code of Conduct.
If it’s finish the job or break the Code, it fails the job.
We’re not racing to build a superintelligence that can slip its own leash.
Interruptible, correctable, shut-down-able. If it isn’t, we don’t ship it.
No neuralese. If humans can’t understand it, humans can’t oversee it.
Our AI should make you sharper, not dependent.
Pluralism, yes. Moral relativism, no.
We’re as clear about what our AI must never do as about what it will do."
All of this seems great to me, and there are some things that I'm especially happy to see. Specifically, point number two: "The idea of model welfare is wrong. AIs should not have rights or legal personhood."
This isn't armchair philosophy: there are actual people (potentially influential ones at that) out there arguing that AI should be ascribed moral rights and so on. This is dangerous because if we start ascribing rights to AI then we may put them on an even footing with us and potentially start thinking we have to do things for 'them' that are to our detriment. Such as keeping the whole AI industry afloat despite any negative effects to real people that are actually conscious.
Speaking of which, Microsoft also states that AI "is not conscious and should not be designed to imitate consciousness." Bingo. I couldn't agree more .
I have some hang-ups about 'humanism' as it is usually defined and practiced today, given that in addition to the baseline human-focused perspective it is also often situated alongside superfluous and misguided doctrines, such as in scientism . Here, though, Microsoft at least seems to be referring to humanism in the simple sense of ensuring that AI is designed to be human-first, putting human control, values, goals, and safety at the forefront.
One potential cause of confusion that I noticed, however, concerns the focus on "plural values":
"Humanity’s greatest strength is its variety and diversity of cultures, ideas, and values. We believe that AI should support a wide range of experiences, worldviews, and beliefs. Humanist AI is built to encompass this diversity of traditions, contexts, and forms of flourishing. Pluralism does not mean neutrality toward harm or that anything goes. Humanism is rooted in broad, inclusive human values such as human dignity, safety, autonomy, and fundamental human rights."
(Image credit: hapabapa via Getty Images) Sounds good, right? But as someone with a background in philosophy who is privy to the kinds of debates that can occur when spending time thoroughly interrogating ethics—debates that likely occur even in the boards of AI ethics committees and so on—I think we need to be aware what a principled problem this poses.
It's not straightforwardly clear that it is possible to both encompass a plurality of values and simultaneously guard against harm. Microsoft makes clear that it's talking about "broad, inclusive human values" such as fundamental human rights, but what about when the rubber meets the road in specific cases where values conflict?
Here is probably not the place, nor is now the time, to discuss specific and likely contentious examples, but the point is that we are always evaluating things from a particular perspective, and as such will always be rejecting competing values. It's a noble goal to attempt to account for diverse values while preventing harm and rejecting moral relativism, but exactly what this means in practice—what constitutes harm and which values are permissible—will be precisely the question.
I suppose in the rest of this code of practice we at least now have some idea of where those particular value flags are being planted. Assuming isn't all just talk, of course.

title: If you need proof The Witcher 3's new expansion is in safe hands, its lead writer literally wrote her thesis on Hearts of Stone: 'To probably prove to some of my professors that games are worthy'
text:
If you need evidence that the team behind The Witcher 3's upcoming expansion, Songs of the Past , is composed of Bonafide Witcher Sickos, try this: the expansion's lead writer wrote her bachelor's thesis on Hearts of Stone almost a decade ago.
Fool's Theory's Paula Mejsner took a comparative literature scalpel to The Witcher 3's first expansion in her 2017 thesis—long before she got to work on the game itself—titled (in English) "Videogames as a way of experiencing literature: Analysis of the 'Hearts of Stone', a DLC to 'The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt'".
When I sat down to chat with her about her work on Songs of the Past , I had to do something that I'd never forgive someone else for doing to me: I asked her about it.
"That was at the time when I played Hearts of Stone, and The Witcher, and I was studying comparative literature. That's when I fell in love with The Witcher… [the thesis] touches upon what I said when it comes to how rich The Witcher is, when it comes to literary references."
Specifically, Mejsner wrote about how The Witcher channeled the spirits of classic Polish literature, "like The Wedding from Wyspiański and the whole character of Gaunter O'Dimm, as this devilish character that is also based on many, many other pieces of culture.
"I wanted to analyse it, and I did this to probably prove to some of my professors that games are worthy, and they are also texts of culture."
As for how the Mejsner of 2017 would feel about actually getting to write an expansion? She'd be pretty thrilled. "To be honest, I'm pretty proud with myself, that I did manage [to work on The Witcher]. But, you know, as always, there's been a lot of luck in the process. But yeah, it truly is a dream come true, because this is what I dreamt of when I wrote my thesis. It's pretty awesome to write Geralt."

title: The Witcher 3 'is not untouchable,' story director says of the upcoming expansion and remaster: 'I still find some places that I think maybe nowadays, I would do it differently'
text:
The Witcher 3 is the perfect videogame. Is that hyperbolic? Maybe a bit. But it's unquestionably one of the greatest RPGs of all time, a game that arrived with a 92% review score and somehow got better through years of fixes, upgrades, and expansions, the last of which provided a perfectly satisfying conclusion to the epic of Geralt (and an even higher review score ).
In his review for that brilliant denouement, former PC Gamer editor Tom Senior committed himself: "If one of these expansions came out every year I'd still be playing The Witcher 3 in 2020." Good news for Tom, then, because a surprise third expansion, Songs of the Past , is on the way in 2027, and a full remaster of the base game and first two expansions is set to drop ahead of that—later this month, in fact. CD Projekt Red has big ambitions for that remaster, aiming to make it not just look and run better, but to feel better too—like a new game, rather than a 2015 release with a fresh coat of paint.
There's clearly a lot going on, and it invites a question: Given the esteem in which The Witcher 3 is held, and the hard-earned ending it granted Geralt, is there any worry about messing with it? For CD Projekt's vice president of narration Marcin Blacha, who served as the lead writer of The Witcher 3 and story director on its two expansions, the answer is an easy 'no.'
"For me, The Witcher 3 is not a monument and is not untouchable," Blacha told us in a recent interview. "It is still vivid in my memory, and it is still something that is not maybe a point of reference, but something that still may be improved. When I'm playing The Witcher 3, I still find some places that I think maybe nowadays, I would do it differently.
"So, you know, adding a new expansion is not such a huge deal. In fact, discovering we still have it, you know, we have this thing, and we are still able to create a story that fits not only vanilla Witcher 3 but also Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine. It is still a very uplifting feeling—a time machine that brings me 10 years back, when I was younger and maybe more passionate and more enthusiastic."
The remastered update is focused on visual and gameplay tweaks, but if he were going to fiddle with narrative elements, what sort of things would Blacha do differently? "Maybe some things I would make more nuanced," he continued, like adjusting Dandelion to make him a bit wiser and more supportive rather than just comedy relief, or adding more choices and consequences in Geralt's dealings with the world around him.
But Blacha also acknowledged that some of those changes would arise not from any problems or shortcoming in the game, but simply because—rather like Geralt—he's changed over the years.
"It may be as well, my process of aging, when I see some things from a different perspective. Maybe the problem is not in the game but in me, looking at the game with a different eye," Blacha said. That doesn't mean Songs of the Past will be the videogame equivalent of a grumpy old man sitting on his porch yelling at the kids, though.
"We have a crew that has both veterans from The Witcher 3, but also developers that joined Fool's Theory or the project quite recently," Blacha said. "So I hope it is not a geriatric expansion. It will be fueled very much by the passion of writers and quest designers and developers of Fool's Theory in general."
The Witcher 3's remastered update is set to launch on September 29, and will be free for anyone who owns the base game. The Songs of the Past expansion is currently slated for a 2027 launch.

title: I am Mark Zuckerberg
text:
Los Santos Customs
I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
Let's skip the preamble: I am Mark Zuckerberg now. The original Mark Zuckerberg? Who cares? He's knocked out in a ditch somewhere. Whatever. He's the past; I am the future. Specifically, the future of Mark Zuckerberg, who I am.
The latest mod I have installed into my increasingly uncontrollable build of Grand Theft Auto 5 is LifeInvader Business Mod , which grants you the ability to buy Rockstar's thinly veiled (which is to say, not veiled at all) parody of Facebook for the cool sum of a million bucks. I did not actually have a million bucks, but one of the 46,000 other mods I have installed let me grant myself that amount at the office's front door. In real life, this is called quantitative easing .
The mod is actually quite robust. It's not just a matter of buying the website and letting passive income roll in. You get a whole new menu through which you can staff up—acquiring devs of varying levels of talent—expand your server capacity, and even hire security to keep the hoi polloi away. You can donate to charity to buff your business' reputation, and have to keep an eye on staff morale.
Staff morale, by the way, is largely unimpacted by the flying car which has careened through the second floor window and begun gyrating around the server racks, gathering a pursuing swarm of monitors and wastepaper baskets behind it like a Saab Pied Piper. Nor do they mind, particularly, when armed men burst in and try to shoot their CEO, and they are equally unfazed when that CEO uses his laser vision to turn those men to hot slag.
(Image credit: Rockstar) Actually, while all this was ongoing, the mod kept serving me notifications: staff morale was at a steady 100% because the boss had showed up in the office, which is both appreciated and also not my experience of what happens when the boss shows up in the office. But Facebo—sorry, LifeInvader's developers are made of a different, hardier stock. It's a privilege to own them.

title: Diablo 4 player discovers secret Diablo 2 easter egg in its new throwback season and now everyone is wondering what else Blizzard hid in there
text:
While server issues stalled the start of Diablo 4's new season for many players, a few were able to get in and discover something Blizzard carefully left out from official materials.
The focus for Diablo 4's Season of Hell's Legacy is celebrating the series' 30th anniversary. Blizzard went back to Diablo 2 and brought back Deckard Cain (in a dream) and three of its most iconic bosses: Diablo, Baal, and Mephisto. Each of them have updated versions of their old models and attacks, too.
Blizzard didn't indicate that it would be doing more than just a nostalgic storyline for season 15—but it is. Diablo 4 streamer Dioxide was able to squeeze past the login issues and found a number of new Runes available. Normally, these slot into your gear and give you passive bonuses, but Dioxide discovered there's more to them than that.
When he dropped two specific runes and a low-quality chestpiece into Diablo 4's crafting table, the Horadric Cube, it showed "???" as the recipe instead of one of the many listed on the side of the interface. When he clicked the transmute button, out popped the Stealth chestpiece, a Unique item from Diablo 2.
It turns out Blizzard added some of the Rune word item recipes from Diablo 2 without telling anyone. The Stealth armor is created exactly as people did more than two decades ago. It has different stats than the original, but carries the same relative power in Diablo 4 because it has two more stats than a normal Unique.
Now everyone is eager to see what other recipes are available and what other things Blizzard has hidden in the new season. The recent trailer has a pretty obvious hint for Diablo 3's rainbow-colored Whimsyshire level near the end with a creepy teddy bear: It isn't clear how to access it, but I'm sure someone will figure it out before the end of the day.
Ever since the release of the Lord of Hatred expansion for Diablo 4, Blizzard has been intentionally leaving stuff for players to find on their own. Nobody knew they would actually add the cow level , for example. I think it's a great approach when so many previous seasons felt kind of solved before they even began, and it maintains some of the mystery that the older games always had.

title: Wardogs delivers what Battlefield 6 was too console-brained to pull off: A real server browser
text:
Here's a neat thought: One of the most popular multiplayer games on the planet right now has no matchmaking button. FPS fans are flocking to Wardogs for its fresh ideas around teamwork, economy, and "all-out warfare." It's pulling in the largest crowds this sort of round-based, milsim-y FPS (a category that also includes Squad and Hell Let Loose) has ever seen.
It's very much filling the Battlefield-shaped hole in my game time, and that's in no small part due to its server browser.
Man, is it nice to press play on a main menu in 2026 and get options like this:
Bulkhead Bulkhead Check out that beaut: A complete list of official servers in my region, sortable by players, ping, rulesets, and maps. And would you look at that: A prominent community section featuring persistent servers rentable from third-party vendors.
No forced matchmaking. No skill-based algorithms. No disbanding lobbies (in community servers, at least). This is exactly the sort of convenient, community-forward setup that still appears regularly in niche milsims and indie shooters , and one that fans have been begging Battlefield to get back to.
(Image credit: Team17) It was around this time last year that EA was making a big to-do about Battlefield 6's community server support. Devs insisted that the Portal server browser, which doesn't support third-party server providers and instead allows players to spin up one semi-persistent lobby at a time, would "tick every box" for a proper server browser.
It did not: At launch, Portal servers were buggy, dominated by XP farming lobbies, and buried under a pile of Netflix menu tiles. As plenty of us predicted , interest in the Portal browser as an alternative to official matchmaking quickly died out, and now it's only good for goofy minigames and, somehow still, XP farming.
(Image credit: EA) When asked at the time why Battlefield 6 couldn't just have a real browser—the kind that lets you see all of the official servers as well as community-hosted ones—DICE lead producer David Sirland offered an answer that, in retrospect, is pretty weak sauce .
"Matchmaking servers spin up in seconds (get filled with players), and spin down after the game is over. That couple of seconds, plus when servers lose a lot of players, mid-game is the only time you can join, which makes it a tricky combination (and full of queuing to join issues)."
And yet, here we are: Wardogs has millions of players, and they seem to be navigating those "issues" just fine. Even the supposed drawbacks of manual browsing are barely a thing in Wardogs. There are currently so many official and community servers that finding one with a few spare slots takes seconds, and players cycle in and out of the 100-player matches so often that queues are rarely a long wait.
(Image credit: David Sirland on X) Meanwhile, the benefits are obvious: Community servers have admins that can punish cheaters and griefers faster than automated tools, and when they're allowed to flourish, these servers can be recognizable social spaces with regulars and customs. Developer Bulkhead isn't doing anything unique here, just what most PC shooters did 20 years ago.
The reality is that pulling off a server browser really comes down to will. Battlefield 6 doesn't have a real, prominent browser because EA doesn'tdon't want one. DICE built it like a console game (really, like Call of Duty) with algorithmic factors that get thrown off when folks can just hop into whatever server they want. So Portal was the compromise—a walled garden with restrictive, fake-persistent access to dedicated servers. It was a miscalculation about where the wind is blowing in the FPS scene, and it's still hurting an otherwise great game.
Wardogs' server browser is far from flawless. Basic features like favoriting and tiered queueing are still on the way, joining a server as a group is harder than it should be, and server admins are missing crucial tools—but it's a strong start for an early access game, and immediately more legitimate than Battlefield 6's sorry excuse for community support. In more ways than one, Battlefield could learn from Wardogs and smaller shooters like it.

title: Steam reverses porn game rating it mistakenly gave to an indie vampire RPG, and despite the stress it was a 'net positive' overall as wishlists on Steam 'basically doubled overnight'
text:
It's a sad day for aficionados of undead porn games, but a good one for pretty much everybody else: Valve has rescinded the adults only rating it had applied to the upcoming narrative RPG Nighthawks , meaning it will appear in standard searches on the storefront and won't be blocked from sale in some regions.
"Phew. What a roller coaster," Dave Gilbert, head of publisher Wadjet Eye Games, wrote on Bluesky. "Thank you everyone for your amazing support while we got this sorted. If you weren't able to wishlist before, now you can!"
I tested for myself, and sure enough, Nighthawks now appears in Steam searches even if you're not logged in. Previously, the adult rating meant it wouldn't show up unless you were logged in and had your account set to display AO-rated games.
In a separate post, Nighthawks developer (and former PC Gamer contributor) Richard Cobbett also expressed relief at the change: "Now I can get back to only stressing over people actually liking it!"
Oh, thank goodness. Now I can get back to only stressing over people actually liking it!
— @richardcobbett.bsky.social ( @richardcobbett.bsky.social.bsky.social ) 2026-09-15T20:03:50.795Z The entire situation was bizarre. Nighthawks, a game about life as a new vampire in a world where the existence of vampires is known, began as a 2018 Kickstarter project; it promised depth, complexity, great storytelling, hand-drawn art, and absolutely nothing about sex.
The same is visible on the Nighthawks Steam page : A little sexy, maybe—it's vampires, after all, and you know how they are—but hardcore sex? Not so much.
Vampires, am I right? (Image credit: Wadjet Eye Games) Complicating matters further, Cobbett told us when the AO rating was first imposed that nobody was really sure what had caused it. "Vampires are inherently a bit sexy, and Nighthawks is definitely a mature game in terms of content," he said over the weekend. "However, regarding nudity, sex, and similar elements specifically, it's really all very mild, usually comedic in tone when it happens, and far less explicit than anything you'd see on HBO."
Why exactly Valve walked the rating back is also a mystery. Gilbert told me in a chat today that Valve didn't give him any "clear insights" into the initial rating, or why it was changed. He did say, however, that "Valve was very helpful in expediting the review on my appeal so we could get the AO rating dropped and the game itself approved for release. Regardless of how and why it happened, they did everything in their power to make it right. So I’m very grateful for that."
The experience of the surprise AO rating was very stressful, Gilbert said, and he was "basically swimming in cortisol" throughout. But he also acknowledged that, with the resolution in place, it was a "net positive" overall, and that the number of wishlists on Steam had "basically doubled overnight."
"I did not expect the whole thing to go as viral as it did. It called a lot more attention to the game that I am normally capable of on my own," he said. "I wish I could say I planned this as a guerrilla marketing stunt, but I’m not that dumb and I’m not that smart!
"I have no illusions that all of those new wishlists are sincere, and that a nonzero chunk of them aren't 'protest wishlists,' but anything that pushes the algorithm into thinking we are popular isn't a bad thing."
With "a decent night's sleep" behind him, Gilbert said he can see the humor in the situation, adding that he'll "be dining out on this story for a long time." He also recognizes, though, that he was very lucky to get the outcome he wanted, as quickly as he did.
"I had the contacts and the fanbase and the (relative) clout to make a bit of noise and get this handled quickly. Many devs in the same situation wouldn't be able to do that," Gilbert said. "At the very least, this has shed a big light on the problem and made Valve aware that this is a big problem many indies face. Hopefully it means that others will have an easier time of it going forward."
Classifying Nighthawks as a hardcore sex game does put a light on the imperfections (and frustrating opacity) of Steam's rating system (and yeah, now that we've got a happy ending we can admit it's kind of funny too), but the sheer number of games on the storefront means change to its classification system may be unlikely: More than 19,000 new games launched on Steam in 2025 alone.
Nighthawks is set to launch on September 22. and alongside Steam will also be available on GOG .

title: Wardogs CEO says he won't hire devs who aren't down with crunch: 'If you care about what you're making, this is the place to work' (Updated)
text:
Update 9/16/26: Responding to coverage of his controversial comments about crunch, Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer has told Eurogamer that crunch is not mandatory at the studio. He had previously stated, "I expect people to crunch. I own that. I don't try and hide it."
"In June 2026 we were late for the Wardogs beta build," Brammer told the publication in a new statement. "In this instance I apologised and said the only way I thought we could get the game into beta, was by working an extra 2 hours a day Monday through Thursday, for 4 weeks (16 working days total). We admitted to the staff that this was crunch; we clearly stated that we needed to crunch. It was optional; four people opted out, nothing happened to them and nothing will. But I can admit that maybe the social pressure within a very tight-knit team might make those individuals feel less than great."
To prevent confusion, we've updated this article's headline, which previously referred to crunch as mandatory, to reflect Brammer's new statement.
Eurogamer also pushed Brammer on Bulkhead's practice of screening the social media accounts of potential applicants to check if they're "constantly tweeting anti-crunch messaging," and if this could potentially violate UK employment law.
"We understand your concern, but I was speaking informally about our culture and the kind of environment we have at Bulkhead, rather than setting out our formal recruitment process," Brammer said.
"Where we do consider publicly available information as part of recruitment, it is done in line with applicable UK employment and data protection law. We don't access private accounts or carry out covert or intrusive checks.
"My comments were really about being upfront about the kind of studio we are and making sure it's the right fit for both sides."
The original story follows.
Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer is catching heat from industry colleagues for his studio's stance on crunch. In the latest episode of The Game Business Show (as covered by Game Developer ), Brammer and host Christopher Dring chatted about Bulkhead's journey as an indie studio and Wardogs' big success before the conversation turned to work culture and crunch.
Brammer was upfront that crunch does happen at Bulkhead, and if you're not OK with that, you're probably not getting hired.
"A lot of people who may have an issue with crunch—rightly so, I understand that issue, we always try and avoid it, but we don’t hide that this is going to happen at some point—they often don't make it in the door. Because we want to be known for that: this is a place you come to work hard. If you care about the work you’re making and the result of what you make here, you'll feel really valued. If you don't, you will feel slave-driven," he said.
"We check people's socials, and if you're constantly tweeting anti-crunch messaging: 'This should never ever be a thing', we know that and go, 'Look, you're not going to be happy here, so we're not going to go with you.'"
Brammer acknowledged that this is a controversial policy in game development, which has made strides to eliminate or limit mandatory crunch following years of reporting detailing the industry's labor exploitation, burnout, and the human cost of a work culture that says you only "care about what you're making," as Brammer says, if you're willing to stay late.
"For the last three months, Wardogs has been more important than a lot of [our team's] family lives. But now, Bulkhead and I have to acknowledge that it needs to go the other way. Everyone’s pushing us to get [the console version] out earlier, and we’ve said, ‘No, that's not how it’s going to work. We can't push them more."
The CEO believes Bulkhead balances the scales by offering bonuses and incentives to some (but definitely not all) of its staff.
"If we're going to be a company that says 'We do crunch,' then you have to get something for it," Brammer said.
On Bluesky, Brammer's game industry colleagues aren't so convinced he's cracked the code.
"There's an endless mountain of peer reviewed, double-blind studies that show this shit doesn't work and *negatively impacts profits* but the facade of looking like you're a big tough special boy is more important," wrote game dev bplane .
"Tell me you need a producer without saying you need a producer," said producer and consultant Nazih Fares .
"Imagine being proud of your attitude towards crunch and calling it 'hard work.' Crunch is a result of bad planning and poor management," wrote Studio Gobo's Michael Howe . "This [interview] stinks of lies and excuses to drag devs through the grinder, may this kind of lead never find me."
How outwardly does Bulkhead embrace crunch? Back on Wardogs launch day, Brammer posted studio tours on X that included a room full of air mattresses for employees working overnight to fix Wardogs' troubled servers.
Alright guys, here’s what it looks like. pic.twitter.com/uvO81fVSyz September 10, 2026

title: As Skyblivion's launch approaches, the team is looking for help to get the word out
text:
The gears are still grinding on Skyblivion , the massive mod that aims to recreate The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion in the newer, prettier technology of The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim Special Edition. A release date still hasn't been announced, but it's definitely getting closer—and once again, the dev team is asking for help.
What's notable, though, is the kind of help the developers are looking for: Not to finish the mod, but to tell the world about it.
As we approach #Skyblivion's launch, we’re looking for volunteers to join our communications team! If you have experience in video production or social media, we’d love your help collaborating on everything from trailer creation to developer interviews.
— @skyblivion.com ( @skyblivion.com.bsky.social ) 2026-09-15T21:47:15.782Z "With our release getting closer, our communications team is expanding—and we need your help spreading the word!" the dev team wrote on the Skyblivion Discord . "We’re looking for volunteers with a background in video production or social media to help support projects like trailer editing, gameplay captures, and developer interviews. You'll be working alongside our communications department to get the word out!"
Nothing about the state of the mod was shared, and that remains the big question. Skyblivion was supposed to be out in 2025 but in December of that year was pushed into 2026 . In April of this year, Skyblivion project lead Rebelzize admitted "there's always the chance shit hits the fan and we suffer another major setback," but added that "from what I see internally, I am pretty optimistic ."
The team has been mostly quiet since then, apart from a couple calls for assistance on Discord and social media, and a tribute to modder Kettlewitch , "a close friend and mentor," who died in June. Gearing up for a promotional push is surely a sign that the end is in sight, but no guarantee of anything imminent—and with less than four months remaining in the year, 'imminent' is just about essential to avoid another delay.
Which would not be the end of the world. Skyblivion is a volunteer project, so fortunes will not be won or lost on its scheduling. But a delay would be disappointing: It's been in development since 2012, and it sure would be nice to get to play it, rather than just talk about it.

title: Blizzard is aware Overwatch fans are tired of seeing its fanciest skins go to the same heroes and it's 'the number one' thing it's working to fix next
text:
Overwatch has over 40 heroes at this point, each with their own legion of fans. Blizzard can't make everyone happy when it comes to releasing new skins, but its most recent skins have fans convinced it's playing favorites.
Heroes who have already been swimming in skins, like Kiriko and Genji, keep getting more and more while other heroes are left with scraps.
Blizzard has started to drop Mythic skins for heroes who already have them, upsetting those who've waited years to see their favorite heroes get their first one. These fancy skins have customizable parts and change the visual effects on abilities. They're also the most expensive skins in the game at around $70, or 80 Mythic Prisms, a currency acquired by completing tiers on the battle pass or purchasing directly from the shop.
Only two Mythic skins come out every season, which is why many players are frustrated seeing some heroes get more while others have none. The ire around repeat Mythics comes up every time another one comes out, but has grown more intense as the trend continues. The recent Mythic Void Widowmaker skin—her second Mythic—saw an overwhelmingly negative response because it arrived in the same season Genji got his second Mythic skin.
In an interview with PC Gamer, art director Dion Rogers said the team never intentionally leaves out certain heroes from Mythic discussions. "It's just more of what the team is excited about in the moment, or the very cool ideas sitting in front of us basically," he said. Some heroes are easier to get to than others, he added.
One shot. One kill. One absolutely stunning Mythic. 🤩Step into the void when you pick up Widowmaker’s new Void Dancer Mythic Skin today 🕷️ pic.twitter.com/PLFNIZ58A9 September 8, 2026
But Rogers said the team has seen the feedback about repeat Mythics and is going to work on spreading them out better in the future. Specifically, he said it'll be "the number one thing" the team will start to conceptualize next.
"We've done recently a big blue-sky sketch, like hit as many as these guys as possible and see if something jumps out ," he said.
Skins presumably take a while to come together, so I wouldn't expect to see a wider variety of Mythics for several months, but it's promising to hear that some of the less conventional heroes might finally get their own time to shine soon.

title: How to fish in Valheim
text:
Wondering how to fish in Valheim? When you're not slaying Odin's enemies in the Norse underworld, it makes perfect sense to kick back with a relaxing bit of fishing. And if you've spent time on a raft or ship, or even just wandered close to a body of water, you've probably already seen a few fish swimming around. But how do you catch them? Don't worry, it's not hard, but you'll need a little bit of gear and a lot of stamina.
Valheim fishing rod: How to get it
It's a bit unfortunate that in a world where you craft all your own gear, you can't craft a fishing rod. But at least there's Haldor, the vendor you'll (eventually) find in the black forest .
Haldor sells fishing rods for 350 coins, and sells 20 pieces of basic bait for 10 coins.
If you haven't found Haldor already, you can check our guide on how to increase your Valheim inventory size for a few tips on locating Valheim's NPC vendor.
If you're a real gambler, you can attempt to find a fishing rod out in the world. They are very rarely found as loot in frost caves in the mountains biome. I'd probably stick with buying one from Haldor, though: I've got over 150 hours in Valheim and I've never found a fishing rod in a frost cave.
How to fish in Valheim
(Image credit: Coffee Stain Publishing) Fishing is stamina based : you'll need to spend stamina to reel your fish in, so prepare yourself as you would going into battle: by eating enough food to give you a full stamina bar and by bringing some stamina meads with you.
With the rod equipped and the bait selected in your inventory (by right-clicking it), press mouse 1 (or your attack button) to cast your line into the water. When a fish swims near and nibbles—your bobbin will be tugged— click mouse 2 (or your block button). That will instantly hook your fish.
To reel in your fish, hold down mouse 2 : that will drain your stamina while reeling in the fish. If you run out of stamina before you finish reeling it in, the fish will escape.
When the fish is close to you, you'll be able to target it with your crosshairs and press E (or your use button) to pick it up.
Fishing tips
(Image credit: Coffee Stain Publishing) Fish are physical entities that spawn into the world, so if you don't see any fish in the water nearby, you're not going to catch anything.
To find fish, run along the edge of the water and try to spot them swimming around, then aim your cast there.
You can also take a boat out into the water to look for groups of fish. Just watch out for sea serpents, which are a little too big to land with a fishing rod.
You can craft bait from fish you catch using the food preparation table. The food preparation table can be made with 5 iron, 15 leather scraps, and 20 finewood.
Make sure you have spare room in your inventory for your catches!
You can also catch fish by hand if you're fast enough. They sometimes wash up on beaches, too.
There's a fishing hat you'll learn to craft by catching at least one of every different fish in Valheim. It gives you a +20 to your fishing skill.

title: I've been waiting all year for the 2nd Chapter to last year's best JRPG remake—it did not disappoint
text:
I had an extremely good time with the Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter last year. As a big fan of the Trails of Cold Steel PC ports, finally getting the opportunity to try the first installment in the beloved JRPG series, with all the modern accoutrements of a full 3D remake , was truly a pleasure.
Falcom really didn't skimp when it came to upgrading the experience to the standard of its newer Trails games. There's only one problem: I wanted more.
Despite 1st Chapter being a pretty well-rounded story—clocking in at a perfectly reasonable 40 hours for me—it ends on a criminal cliffhanger. It's easy to see why so many say that 2nd Chapter is really just the second part of the first game, something I probably should've clocked considering the naming convention.
But having played Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Remake this last week or so, I can say it feels more like a victory lap, building on the setting, characters, and quests you completed in the first. It's very much what you'd expect from the middle child of a JRPG trilogy—the cogs are turning, the characters moving, we're going somewhere .
2nd Chapter's Bracer requests feel a bit trickier Falcom With save import, many characters from the first game will remember you Falcom The banter is also extremely good Falcom Lots of great character moments Falcom Olivier and Estelle's relationship continues to be my fav Falcom While I won't spoil too much, 2nd Chapter feels like a bit more of a coming of age story for Estelle, as she finds herself adrift as a newly-made Senior Bracer. With the help of familiar faces, you'll travel around Liberl investigating the activities of Ouroborous, the secret society who reared their head in the previous game.
So yes, it's the classic Trails recipe: cosy and comfy odd-jobbing as you help the citizens of Liberl, but with a dash of uncovering and foiling grand nefarious schemes. I'm about 30 hours into 2nd Chapter, but it feels very much like your typical Trails game in that sense—good news if that's what you like. I know I do.
There are a few improvements that jumped out at me, though, having played the 1st Chapter Remake so recently:
The Bracer requests and puzzles are a lot better . I had one where I had to fix a lighthouse by reading a manual, another where I undertook a criminal investigation, and another where I literally had to beat a guy at poker, all which I could've failed.
The new combat and craft animations look really good , both in terms of characters and bosses, who now have S-breaks.
The party rostering is much improved . Though I love characters popping up and then disappearing JRPG-style, 2nd Chapter does a much better job of giving you a consistent roster and more character choice. Early in the game you'll even get to choose between two semi-permanent party members.
You may often be revisiting the same locations, but it's nice that the quests you completed also carry over from your 1st Chapter save data. There are so many NPCs you'll bump into who'll be like "Oh, I remember you helping my gran find her hearing aid." But the situation in each region will also feel different, like the story of Liberl has moved forward.
Falcom Falcom And, of course, you've got the same excellent character banter. Estelle is on top form, but I genuinely found myself getting engrossed in her emotional turmoil, yet drive to fight for the truth and closure. Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter isn't as revolutionary as 1st Chapter was, but it's a strong sequel that certainly builds on what made the first remake so good.
If you want to play it yourself, it's out on September 17, or you can try the Steam demo first. You can also play the demo for the 1st Chapter , which is currently 50% off—I assume to coincide with 2nd Chapter's release.

title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter has one of the creepiest JRPG monsters I've encountered
text:
Let's face it: JRPG monsters are pure nightmare fuel. Sure, there's a certain subset who are plain ol' cute, but for the most part they're a horrifying mash up of real world animals and mythical monsters, chimeric creatures amalgamating whatever bits and pieces the artist decided to chuck in the blender that day.
Not that I'm complaining, mind you—it wouldn't be a JRPG for me without them. I took absolute delight in Metaphor: ReFantazio's "humans" when I finally got around to playing it last Christmas, a wonderful take on the idea of what a monster even is, channeling Hieronymus Bosch's 500 year old paintings into some extremely distressing bosses.
But I never thought I'd find a top tier creepy JRPG monster in a Trails game. The series does have its darker moments, but for the most part, it's pretty homely and rustic, following the lives of regular folk. Trails in the Sky in particular is very chill, as you wander around Liberl as Joshua and Estelle, completing requests and odd jobs to earn their Bracer stripes.
However, while playing the Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Remake recently, I ran into a monster in Kaldia Tunnel in the game's Zeiss region who freaked me out. The Faerie Epitaph was in the original game and kind of resembles a melted angel statue, but with this full 3D remake, Falcom added a fun trick to this monster.
The Faerie Epitaph doesn't move, at least, not when you're looking at it . As you can see in the video, it moves Weeping Angel-style, inching closer whenever you look away. Obviously, I hit the first Faerie Epitaph I saw because it's clearly a monster, but it took me quite a while to realise that another was following me around Kaldia Tunnel. I only clocked it when I turned around after opening a chest and came face-to-face with one. Maybe it's just me, still scarred from the first time I watched Blink, but monsters that move when you're not looking are uniquely terrifying.
It's such a wonderfully creepy little detail to add as part of a full 3D remake, but it's kind of indicative of the lengths Falcom has gone to reworking these games for modern audiences. As a fan of Trails of Cold Steel, I was super impressed by Trails in the Sky's 1st Chapter Remake last year, and I've been having a great time with the 2nd Chapter Remake so far—when I'm not getting spooked by monsters, that is.

title: Where have all the RTX 5090s gone? Stock of the high-end GPU is disappearing from US online retailers
text:
Alas, my series 'I'd do anything for an Nvidia RTX 5090 at MSRP, but I won't do that' has been cancelled after one episode, on account of the fact the card has seemingly disappeared from most major US retailers.
What remains are online listings from third-party sellers, often asking for a price even higher above MSRP, as spotted by Tom's Hardware . Previously, it's been cheaper for me to hop on an international flight to PAX West or QuakeCon , and pick up an RTX 5090 at the event for the $1,999/£1,939 MSRP than buy it anywhere else. This will come as no surprise for those who have been keeping track of our graphics card price watch , where we've seen the RTX 5090 go up 83% in price and even breach the $6,000 sound barrier.
What our Dave most recently recommended as the cheapest option, this Gigabyte Windforce RTX 5090 from Newegg was $5,700 just last Thursday. Now it's a frankly offensive $9050 from a third-party reseller. The same card is sold out on Amazon and Best Buy . But the cheapest new RTX 5090 I've been able to find is the Asus TUF, again from a reseller, for $6,800 .
Don't even get me started on how things are looking in the UK—though, for those curious, Dave's tireless efforts did find the Zotac RTX 5090 going for £3,940 from Scan . That's still too rich for my cup of tea.
So, where is all the stock going? Well, some deep-pocketed consumers are definitely snapping up at least a few cards. Recent research suggests a trend that 'defies common wisdom', with folks buying more high-end graphics cards despite rising prices, to the tune of 12.5 million shipped last quarter alone .
Nvidia still enjoys a 90% share of the market according to that same report from John Peddie research. But given company CEO Jensen Huang recently shared that 100,000 Nvidia GPUs were used to train OpenAI's latest model, GPT-6 Astra —not to mention there's already plans to bring quadruple that amount of hardware online—I'll give you three guesses why there are so few RTX 5090s available for consumers.
It's likely not RTX 5090 cards being used specifically to train Astra, but it's still possible that other AI firms are buying up the high-ends cards to adorn their server PCs in lieu of datacenter accelerators or RTX Pro 6000 GPUs. RTX 5090 pallet images shared by HKEPC imply as much (via VideoCardz ).
Okay, I'll also give you this for free: Nvidia may not be producing fewer 4nm GB20x Blackwell chips on the whole, but may simply be shifting more of that stock towards its professional products —like workstations—instead. That's still going to leave fewer gaming GPUs to go around, and we're back where we started with runaway RTX 5090 prices.

title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons won't have waypoints, so that players can figure things out without 'blindly trusting' a UI
text:
I have shifted from a position of 'really? A third-person action D&D game?' to cautiously optimistic about the upcoming Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons. Partially because of a really solid showing at Gamescom , actually leveraging the prospect of playing a spellcaster with a bunch of interesting interactions and some swanky-looking combat.
My optimism continues to grow after an interview with IGN , in which general manager Dominic Guay tells the site that the game will be getting rid of traditional quest markers—there's a compass you can turn off, but that's about it: "We wanted them to engage with the world, to figure things out and feel that when they found things, it was based on their actions and not just blindly trusting a waypoint."
While I'm not always opposed to a waypoint—it really depends on the kind of game—I can say that a surplus of hand-holding is always irritating. Developer Invoke Studios has lucked into a topical time to talk about this stuff, too, since such obnoxious waypointery has made us feel a lot better about not getting the PS5 exclusive Wolverine anytime soon.
Guay continues that "the core team on this game have worked on other open world games before and we've done the, let's say, the heavy-handed guiding approach before. What ends up happening at some point—and it's normal—a lot of players will just [blindly follow] the waypoint, and then you lose that agency, you lose that feeling of curiosity because you're like, well, why even bother? And so we didn't want to go there. We wanted the player to explore."
Instead of typical quests, the game revolves around "Mysteries", which sound like a sort of light immersive sim way of going about things. Like asking for rumours in a D&D game, players can bumble around town chatting to NPCs to accrue clues and information—creating the illusion of stumbling across something organically.
"Not only are there multiple entry points, but depending on how you stumble upon them, it might change how you interact with them … You can chance upon that Mystery from a completely different place, and then it'll lead you toward that settlement, and you'll know before coming in there's something fishy going on here. So then you'll approach that settlement differently than in this case where you learn it from within."
Not all of these mysteries are so straightforward—but this all sounds pretty solid to me. What'll really make this system good is whether Invoke Studios can pull it off in a way that feels natural. Creating the illusion that I'm some super-smart warlock detective is neat on paper, but if every beggar I bump into starts talking about a sinister basement, I might feel just as coddled as I am with big glowing map markers and prompts. Or yellow paint. At least we aren't doing yellow paint again.
